name: Rayan Zaidi
source:
Rayan is a modern and contemporary art teacher at Antéros Academy. Charismatic and evidently passionate about his work, his teaching approach captivates and sometimes unsettles students. While he is approachable outside the classroom, he often finds it challenging to conceal his inner turmoil.

He likes philosophical conversations and good romantic comedies.
He doesn't like reality TV shows and people who let their tastes and way of thinking be dictated to them.
